services.desc: The secret becomes evident as soon as you board the Fourth Watch. As the sails are hoisted, daily stresses slip away with the wind. Choose from our carefully curated sailing experiences, each designed to create unforgettable memories on Lake Grapevine. Every charter features the comfort and elegance of the Fourth Watch, a Ted Hood-designed Bristol 47.7 Global Cruiser. Weekend and holiday sunset charters are in especially high demand and are often reserved well in advance. During these peak sailing times, reservations totaling $500 or more receive scheduling priority. We recommend booking early to secure your preferred sunset experience.
